object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. A commit refused because the latest commit moved (CF-V14) isn't tested; see the gaps.
object.description: Change the author to bob and the date in the commit dialog, then make the commit fail with a git error reported by Mellon, and with a raw git error. Then make a commit land and fail only afterwards. Expected: after each failure the manifest's bytes are as before the dialog's edit and the document's author is 'tester'; when the commit had landed, the manifest stays as committed, with author bob.
